additional_info.subject: ID0416468-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PD 312571675/25] Charging issue CRM:00796001484
additional_info.body:
Hello Sebastien,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
ENGIE VIANEO
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / PD 312571675/25
Charger ID/Serial No.:
Y2 / PD 312571675/25
Problem Description: Charging issue
Upon reviewing the logs, you attached in the ticket, I kindly request you to check the charging plug and verify the PT1000 temperature sensor resistance table to ensure the resistance values are correct according to the temperature.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,

additional_info.body:
Dear Antoine,
I hope this email finds you well!
As part of our Customer Service team's global initiative to clean up our ticketing backlog, we're reaching out to help streamline our open cases.
During a recent review of our ISP ticketing system, we noticed several aging tickets that need a quick status check. We're here to help make this process as smooth as possible for you.
Would you be able to help us confirm:
If any repair/resolution has been completed
Whether any follow-up actions are still pending
Any relevant comments about the current situation
Don't worry about the administrative part - our central Customer Service team will take care of closing the tickets once you confirm their status.
If you could add any brief comments that might be helpful for documentation and provide your confirmation by replying to this email, that would be great!
Thanks so much for your help with this initiative! If you need any assistance or have questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.
With best regards,
